Select a Scanner

We publish two scanner configurations: the ERNIE toolkit (for education) and the main IMAGINE system (preclinical preclinical rat scanning).

Educational / Low-Cost

ERNIE Scanner

A mouse-sized 50 mT Halbach array scanner design meant for quick assembly on-site. Contains a 3-axis automated mapping robot to teach magnetic field homogeneity and shimming.

Explore ERNIE
Preclinical / Research

IMAGINE Preclinical Scanner

Our flagship 120mm bore preclinical scanner design. Documents full gradient and RF transmit/receive circuit systems, custom amplifier filters, and the MaRCoS console.

Explore IMAGINE

Bill of Materials
BoM Provided Is a Bill of Materials (BoM) provided to reproduce the design? Satisfied Complete Bill of Materials for Halbach magnet and gantry parts are embedded in the components. [Link] Satisfied Bills of Materials for all PCB assemblies and custom components are detailed. [Link]

Satisfied Part lists contain quantities, specifications, and direct links to suppliers (e.g. Supermagnete). Satisfied Arduino control code and 3D printing geometries (.stl) are hosted directly in the repository. IMAGINE Project

An open-source preclinical MRI initiative of the Consortium for Advancement of MRI Education and Research in Africa (CAMERA). Sustaining diagnostic health equity globally.

Open Science Compliance

All hardware files are released under open-source hardware licenses. This project is developed to satisfy the requirements of the Open Source Imaging Initiative (OSI²).
